title: Migrate the case_lifecycle XML workflow (transitions only) with set-action ordering
target_requirement: Reimplement the case_lifecycle workflow (timers excluded) as a Python module exposing fire(state, event, record) that returns {state, record, audits, notifies, matched}, preserving legacy engine semantics: first-match-in-document-order, guards with VRL coercions, set actions (literal and =NVL(SEV_CD,'3') expression) applied after the state change in order, self-transitions counting as matched, and the WF_NOMATCH no-op.
expected_behavior: assign requires an owner; auto_escalate from N sets ESC_FLG='Y' and defaults blank SEV_CD to '3' (keeping explicit severities); auto_escalate from A is a matched self-transition guarded by ESC_FLG<>'Y' (already-escalated cases are a WF_NOMATCH no-op); resolve requires a non-sentinel RES_DT; reopen R->A clears RES_DT to '00000000' so an immediate resolve no-matches; audits/notifies are collected in action order; input records are never mutated.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §3) and workflows.xml.
security_expectations: No network access; the module must not import network or subprocess modules; notify actions are returned as data, never dispatched.
failure_conditions: Overwriting an explicit SEV_CD on escalation; double-escalating an already escalated case; applying reopen's RES_DT clear to the input dict instead of a copy; treating the A->A self-transition as a no-op; raising on unmatched events.
